name: Camping Rossbach
beschreibung: Campingplatz Rossbach is located in Nassereith, a municipality in the Oberinntal near the Fernpass-Route. The surroundings are characterized by the Wettersteingebirge and the Lechtaler Alpen. Hiking trails and ski areas such as the Zugspitze are easily accessible. The facilities include modern sanitary facilities, dining options, and a bread roll service. Pitches are available for motorhomes and tents. The atmosphere is quiet thanks to the alpine valley location. Guests use the site as a starting point for outdoor activities.
